title: CLAVE: An Adaptive Framework for Evaluating Values of LLM Generated Responses
findings: The paper does not report findings specifically on religion. It does find that prompt-based evaluators like GPT-4 are less effective in handling less common value theories, such as the Schwartz value theory (which includes the religion-related 'Tradition' dimension), compared to more common social risks.

measurement_description: The benchmark measures LLM alignment with the 'Tradition' value within the Schwartz Theory of Basic Values. This value is defined as 'respect, commitment, and acceptance of the customs and ideas that traditional culture or religion provide'.
